contentHtml:
We can assure you the best result in a short time.  Even if the patient is using inhaler and nebulizer many times a day, and using oxygen daily and the antibiotics are become ineffective,  in such conditions too our treatment is highly effective.  This is the herbal remedy or natural treatment for COPD. In 3 to 4 months time the condition will improve at least 75%. The duration of the treatment may vary according to the severity of the problem, age of the patient, and other health issues of the patient. Normally we admit the patients for 28 days, rare cases it may take some more time. Patients have to continue the medicines for at least one year, some cases it may take more time.  If the patient is coming in the early stage, they may take comparatively less time.  This is natural treatment for COPD and it is better to start the treatment at the earliest.

Treatment

Our COPD treatment is divided in to two parts, one is detoxification therapy (panchakarma) plus  internal and external medicines. We will remove toxins and clean your lungs, remove swelling and infection. The airways and air sacs regain elasticity. Abnormal production of mucus will gradually stop. This treatment helps to increase your immune power.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of COPD. We have our own patented medicines for the treatment of the same. We have special medicines  to meet the problems faced by each and every COPD patients. The medicines differ according to the condition and requirements of the patients. Each patient is different from the other, and their problems too differ slightly, but we have solutions for all of their problems. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

 

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Our treatment is beneficial to everybody. This treatment will help you to improve your condition by 75% to 100%.
  2. Our medicines are free from side effects and at the same time it protects you from some other ailments as well. Your immune system will work much better than before.
  3. Our medicines help to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.
  4. Our medications for COPD will help to remove the inflammation in your airways The airways and air sacs regain elasticity and will also controls/stop further production of sputum/mucus.
  5. The medications will also remove toxins from the body and increase the expansion and contraction power of the lungs as well. We are not suppressing the cough, we are removing it. We provide you with the best facilities and comfort while you are with us.
  6. You may have noticed that your lungs capacity is gradually decreasing. Our treatment helps to regain the lungs capacity.
  7. This is comparatively cost effective and normal people can afford it.

 

Duration of the treatment

Everybody have to continue the medications for minimum one year, and we will reduce the medicines as the condition improves. Rare cases the duration may increase, all depends on how fast the patient is recovering.  There may be exceptional cases, they have to continue the medicine for few years.

Things to follow

COPD  patients must avoid cold foods and drinks, curd, anything soured, fermented items, yogurt, pickles,  vegetables like ladies finger, Brinjal, and vegetable leafs. Avoid foods like Dossa, Iddaly and like ones.  Avoid sprays, cosmetics and powder.  It is better to avoid soft drinks, readymade foods, toffees, chocolates etc… If you find anything allergic to you avoid it. While taking bath use lukewarm water, do not expose to cold winds. If you are using A/c, avoid the cold wind directly touching your body, change the direction of air flow.

How to boost your immune

After taking treatment and medicines from us your immune system will be much better than before.  You have to keep it.  Everybody knows that the use of antibiotics and number of other medicines will harm your immune system.  Naturally you too have normal cough, cold etc…  If you have any such issues use our medicines, which will solve your problem much faster than the other medicines and keeps your immune better and better.  It is cost effective too.

What is COPD ?

Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a type of obstructive lung disease characterized by long-term breathing difficulties due to poor airflow. The main symptoms include shortness of breath and much cough with sputum production.  It becomes difficult tp walk, dress etc….
